I kept the old fields because ARCH-4 says billing-service and analytics-ingest consume this event, and a straight rename would break them. Both old fields are marked `@deprecated` in `src/core/events.ts`, and each pair carries the same value. I left `schemaVersion` at 3 because the change is additive.

I also added assertions to `test/app.test.ts` that `amountCents` equals the total and `createdAt` equals `placedAt`.

I didn't touch the `GET /orders` and `GET /orders/{id}` responses. Your request named only the event, and ARCH-8 requires `GET /orders/{id}` to stay backward compatible.

To finish the rename, confirm with the billing-service and analytics-ingest teams that they've moved to the new names. After that, `totalCents` and `placedAt` can be removed, probably with a `schemaVersion` bump.
